answer.reason: December 2024 Oregon private-sector construction employment in QCEW covered jobs is 109,828, consistent with seasonal lower winter construction employment; 113,276 is not the December value.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Oregon, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 23 Construction?

A. 109,828 covered jobs
B. 113,276 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Oregon statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/41000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: A
